test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person crosses a 750 m long street in 5 minutes. Find his speed in km/h.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the street = 750 m

Time taken to cross = 5 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

1 km = 1000 m

1 hour = 60 minutes

**Calculation:**

First, convert distance into km and time into hours.

Distance = 750 m = 750 / 1000 km = 0.75 km

Time = 5 minutes = 5 / 60 hours

⇒ Speed = 0.75 km / (5 / 60) hours

⇒ Speed = 0.75 × (60 / 5) km/h

⇒ Speed = 0.75 × 12 km/h

⇒ Speed = 9 km/h

**The speed of the person is 9 km/h.**
